text: $agent-seat model 3 different types of computer desk(s)
resolution: Modeled three separate meter-scale computer desks in the live editor: a 1.20m compact writing desk with full side panels and cable spine, a 1.60m executive pedestal desk with inset cabinet fronts, and a 1.40m adjustable standing desk with mirrored lift columns, flared transitions, T-feet, and height control. Each was built through resident topology operations, named semantically, atlas-painted, saved, and verified healthy across saved/mount/resident semantics. No model files were committed per repository instruction.
